_comment: Country-label fixes keyed by venue_key (venue|city). Some sources (esp. broadway.org tours) file Canadian/Mexican tour stops under USA; reverse-geocoding the coord (scrapers/verify_geo.py) gives the true country. Applied to shows in build_shows.py so both the map and theatres.html group the venue correctly.
_note_lugano: lac - lugano arte e cultura|lugano 這筆自 2026-09-02 起【冗餘但刻意保留】:scrapers/italy.py 已用 NON_IT_CITIES 直接輸出 Switzerland,不再需要事後修正。留著是雙保險——若那個修正被回退,這裡仍會擋住,不會讓提契諾的場館又靜悄悄變回義大利。
